prompt_text: You are a radiology assistant. Look at the displayed PET image (128x128 pixels). Return the smallest single axis-aligned outer bounding box that encloses ALL bright uptake regions (high-intensity blobs) of the image. Coordinates must be in pixel space, where (0, 0) is the top-left and (128, 128) is the bottom-right of the image. Return ONLY a JSON object with keys box {xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax} and rationale. Do not include any other text. Example: {"box": {"xmin": 30, "ymin": 25, "xmax": 70, "ymax": 65}, "rationale": "bright blob"}.
